verdict.rationale: The README recommends a "code builder" for exploring parameter combinations of the Reader API, which is an interactive exploration tool. It also provides copy-paste curl examples that can be run directly against the live endpoints. However, there is no evidence of a full interactive API reference with in-browser try-it execution, and probes found no machine-readable OpenAPI spec at any candidate path. Missing for 10: documented interactive API reference with in-page runnable requests, a published OpenAPI/Swagger spec, detail on what the code builder actually does, and independent hands-on corroboration.
